#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "${MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS:-}" = "1" ]; then
  # checked-push sets an expected tuple when only the expensive gate is skipped.
  if [ -n "${MIPSTARRE_EXPECTED_PUSH_TUPLE:-}" ]; then
    if ! IFS= read -r ACTUAL_PUSH_TUPLE; then
      echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checked ref is already current."
      exit 0
    fi
    if IFS= read -r EXTRA_PUSH_TUPLE; then
      echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: expected exactly one advertised ref tuple." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if [ "$ACTUAL_PUSH_TUPLE" != "$MIPSTARRE_EXPECTED_PUSH_TUPLE" ]; then
      echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: advertised ref tuple changed after preflight." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: confirmed preflight ref tuple."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push hook skipped by MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS=1."
  exit 0
fi

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$ROOT"

CHANGED_FILE_LIST="$(mktemp)"
CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST" "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST"' EXIT
BLUEPRINT_WEB_SMOKE_RAN=0

ZERO_SHA="0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"

run_outside_git_env() (
  for name in $(git rev-parse --local-env-vars); do
    unset "$name"
  done
  "$@"
)

lean_file_to_module() {
  path="${1%.lean}"
  printf '%s\n' "$path" | tr '/' '.'
}

while read LOCAL_REF LOCAL_SHA REMOTE_REF REMOTE_SHA
do
  if [ -z "${LOCAL_SHA:-}" ] || [ "$LOCAL_SHA" = "$ZERO_SHA" ]; then
    continue
  fi

  if [ "$REMOTE_SHA" = "$ZERO_SHA" ]; then
    if git rev-parse --verify origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      BASE_SHA="$(git merge-base "$LOCAL_SHA" origin/main)"
    else
      BASE_SHA="$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 "$LOCAL_SHA" | tail -n 1)"
    fi
  else
    BASE_SHA="$REMOTE_SHA"
  fi

  git diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR "$BASE_SHA" "$LOCAL_SHA" -- >> "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"
done

sort -u "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST" -o "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"
grep -E '^(MIPStarRE/.*\.lean|MIPStarRE\.lean)$' "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST" \
  > "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST" || true

if [ ! -s "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: no changed tracked files detected."
  exit 0
fi

if [ -s "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checking changed Lean files."
  while read LEAN_FILE
    do
      if [ -f "$LEAN_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  lake env lean $LEAN_FILE"
        run_outside_git_env lake env lean "$LEAN_FILE"
      fi
    done < "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST"
fi

if [ -s "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST" ] ||
    grep -Eq '^scripts/(check_oversized_lean_files\.py|tests/test_check_oversized_lean_files\.py)$' \
      "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checking Lean file length guard."
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/check_oversized_lean_files.py --root .
fi

if grep -Eq '^(MIPStarRE/LDT/.*\.lean|MIPStarRE/LDT\.lean|MIPStarRE\.lean)$' "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"; then
  if grep -Fxq 'MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/AxiomAudit.lean' "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: axiom audit already checked as a changed Lean file."
  else
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checking LDT axiom audit."
    run_outside_git_env lake env lean MIPStarRE/LDT/Test/AxiomAudit.lean
  fi
fi

if grep -Eq '^(MIPStarRE/|MIPStarRE\.lean$|blueprint/src/|blueprint/lean_decls|scripts/(audit_new_proof_obligation_metadata|audit_paper_facing_proof_debt|audit_conclusion_shaped_hypotheses|audit_unfaithful_markers|audit_lean_axiom_declarations|check_paper_gap_note_style|check_statement_paper_origin|check_source_statement_changes|blueprint_lean_sync|lean_header_utils)\.py|docs/(CONTRIBUTING|project_conventions|anti_patterns|blueprint_style_guide|formalization-patterns|proof_frontier_review)\.md|docs/paper-gaps/|\.github/(actions|prompts|workflows)/|AGENTS\.md)' "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checking statement-integrity audits."
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: do not close proof gaps by adding non-paper bridge/package hypotheses."
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/check_paper_gap_note_style.py \
    --root . \
    --changed-files-file "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST" \
    --ci
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/check_statement_paper_origin.py --root .
  if git rev-parse --verify origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ -s "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST" ]; then
      run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/audit_new_proof_obligation_metadata.py \
        --root . \
        --base origin/main \
        --changed-files $(cat "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST") \
        --ci
    else
      run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/audit_new_proof_obligation_metadata.py \
        --root . \
        --base origin/main \
        --changed-files \
        --ci
    fi
  else
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: origin/main not found; skipping new proof-obligation metadata guard."
  fi
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/audit_paper_facing_proof_debt.py --root . --ci
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/audit_conclusion_shaped_hypotheses.py --root . --ci
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/audit_unfaithful_markers.py --root . --ci
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/audit_lean_axiom_declarations.py --root . --ci
fi

if [ -s "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST" ]; then
  if git rev-parse --verify origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checking source-labelled statement headers."
    run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/check_source_statement_changes.py \
      --root . \
      --base origin/main \
      --changed-files $(cat "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST")
  else
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: origin/main not found; skipping source statement header guard."
  fi
fi

if grep -Eq '^blueprint/src/' "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"; then
  if ! command -v leanblueprint >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: blueprint/src changed, but leanblueprint is not on PATH."
    echo "Install it with:"
    echo "  pipx install leanblueprint"
    echo "  pipx inject --include-apps --force leanblueprint plastex"
    echo "Or bypass only for a local tooling problem with MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS=1 and let CI run."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: running blueprint web smoke check."
  run_outside_git_env sh -c 'cd blueprint && leanblueprint web'
  BLUEPRINT_WEB_SMOKE_RAN=1
fi

if grep -Eq '^(blueprint/src/|scripts/(check_blueprint_latex|tex_utils)\.py$)' "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checking blueprint LaTeX conventions."
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/check_blueprint_latex.py --root blueprint/src
fi

if grep -Eq '^(MIPStarRE/|MIPStarRE\.lean$|blueprint/|scripts/(blueprint_lean_sync|blueprint_leanok_axioms|check_blueprint_latex|check_blueprint_sync|tex_utils)\.py$)' "$CHANGED_FILE_LIST"; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: regenerating blueprint/lean_decls."
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/blueprint_lean_sync.py --root . --update-lean-decls
  if ! git diff --quiet -- blueprint/lean_decls; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: blueprint/lean_decls changed; stage and commit it before pushing."
    git diff -- blueprint/lean_decls
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: checking blueprint and Lean declaration sync."
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/blueprint_lean_sync.py --root . --ci
  if [ -s "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST" ]; then
    if git rev-parse --verify origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: warning on changed Lean declarations missing blueprint tags."
      run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/blueprint_lean_sync.py \
        --root . \
        --warn-missing-blueprint \
        --diff-base origin/main \
        --changed-files $(cat "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST")
    else
      echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: origin/main not found; skipping reverse blueprint coverage warning."
    fi

    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: refreshing compiled Lean modules for checkdecls."
    while read LEAN_FILE
      do
        if [ -f "$LEAN_FILE" ]; then
          LEAN_MODULE="$(lean_file_to_module "$LEAN_FILE")"
          echo "  lake build $LEAN_MODULE"
          run_outside_git_env lake build "$LEAN_MODULE"
        fi
      done < "$CHANGED_LEAN_FILE_LIST"
  fi
  run_outside_git_env lake exe checkdecls blueprint/lean_decls
fi

if [ "${MIPSTARRE_HOOK_FULL:-}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push full mode: running lake build."
  run_outside_git_env lake build

  echo "MIPStarRE pre-push full mode: checking blueprint proof-level leanok closure."
  run_outside_git_env python3 scripts/blueprint_leanok_axioms.py --ci

  if [ "$BLUEPRINT_WEB_SMOKE_RAN" = "1" ]; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push full mode: blueprint web already checked."
  elif command -v leanblueprint >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push full mode: running leanblueprint web."
    run_outside_git_env sh -c 'cd blueprint && leanblueprint web'
  else
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-push full mode: leanblueprint not found; skipping web build."
  fi
fi

echo "MIPStarRE pre-push: ok."

| `statement-origin` | `statement-origin` (`:447-487`) | `check_statement_paper_origin.py --root .` | `ldt_lean ∨ scripts ∨ workflow` |

Every step is blocking. The single advisory sub-check is
`check_duplicate_private_helpers.py`: exit 1 means "candidates reported" and is
downgraded to a warning, any other nonzero status is a real failure — the same
`set +e` dance as `pr-ci.yml:432-445`.

Two GitHub-only behaviours are dropped on purpose: `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`
blocks and `::error` / `::notice` / `::warning` annotations are inert outside
Actions, so the step's stdout+stderr log **is** the summary. `--github-annotations`
is not passed to `check_duplicate_private_helpers.py`. Exit-code semantics are
preserved exactly: `::warning` never failed a job, and the `^ERROR:` grep
always did.

### Steps that did not run

A step whose area did not change is recorded `skipped` with the reason — never
omitted. A skipped step is green for the merge gate, exactly as a skipped
GitHub job is. This is why the gating globs are load-bearing (§3): a glob that
under-matches turns a real gate into a permanent, invisible `skipped`.

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$ROOT"
HOOK_ROOT="$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
GIT_LOCAL_ENV_VARS="$(git rev-parse --local-env-vars)"

run_without_git_local_env() (
  # Git exports repository-local variables while running hooks.  Several script
  # tests create temporary repositories; keep those tests independent of this
  # checkout.
  unset $GIT_LOCAL_ENV_VARS
  "$@"
)

# A merge commit can be syntactically valid while its index has been reset to
# the first-parent tree.  That failure mode silently discarded clean incoming
# additions on issue-109 and issue-110 (issue #222).  Check the pending index
# before every other gate, including the documented blanket hook bypass: a
# missing incoming path is valid only when the branch deleted a base path.
MERGE_HEAD_PATH="$(git rev-parse --git-path MERGE_HEAD)"
if [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking the merge result for silent incoming loss."
  python3 "$HOOK_ROOT/local/bin/merge_loss_guard.py" --repo "$ROOT"
fi

# Scope-control guard (EVOLUTION.md 2026-09-01, the issue-0007 overbuild):
# workflow scaffolding is budgeted at <=1000 changed lines per commit (400 until the owner raised it on 2026-09-05).  This is
# mechanical enforcement — repeated verbal correction of scaffolding bloat did
# not stick, so the budget lives in the hook.  The override env var is granted
# by the OWNER per commit, never self-granted by an agent session.  Runs
# before the ACMR early-exit so deletion-only commits are counted too
# (numstat includes deletions; PR 7 round 3, F8), and before the
# MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS exit so a blanket hook skip cannot launder the
# owner-only budget override.
# A merge that carries main stages already-reviewed content.  A merge head
# contained in github/main measures the budget against MERGE_HEAD; a merge head
# that contains github/main (a parent branch of a stack that already merged
# main; owner decision 2026-09-05) measures it against github/main, so inherited
# main content counts zero while the PR's cumulative workflow diff and any
# side-branch content beyond main still count.  Any other side-branch merge
# stays budgeted against HEAD.
if [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ] &&
    git merge-base --is-ancestor MERGE_HEAD refs/remotes/github/main 2>/dev/null; then
  BUDGET_BASE="$(git rev-parse MERGE_HEAD)"
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: main-history merge; budget measured against MERGE_HEAD."
elif [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ] &&
    git merge-base --is-ancestor refs/remotes/github/main MERGE_HEAD 2>/dev/null; then
  BUDGET_BASE="$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/github/main)"
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: non-main merge carrying github/main; workflow-layer content beyond github/main is budgeted."
else
  BUDGET_BASE=""
  if [ -f "$MERGE_HEAD_PATH" ]; then
    echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: non-main merge; workflow-layer merge content is budgeted."
  fi
fi
INFRA_CHANGED="$(git diff --cached --numstat $BUDGET_BASE -- local/ .githooks/ \
  scripts/tests/test_dispatch.py scripts/tests/test_github_workflow.py \
  scripts/tests/test_lake_root.py scripts/tests/test_pre_push_hook.py \
  scripts/tests/test_ready_packets.py scripts/tests/test_merge_loss_guard.py \
  | awk '{added=$1; deleted=$2; if (added != "-") total+=added+deleted} END {print total+0}')"
if [ "${INFRA_CHANGED:-0}" -gt 1000 ] && [ "${MIPSTARRE_INFRA_OVERRIDE:-}" != "1" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: staged workflow-layer change is ${INFRA_CHANGED} lines (budget: 1000)."
  echo "Scope control (local/personas/main.md): the budget is PER EPISODE, not per"
  echo "commit — serial oversized commits are the same violation and show in the"
  echo "telemetry. Shrink the change, or ask the OWNER to authorize this commit"
  echo "with MIPSTARRE_INFRA_OVERRIDE=1 (self-granting it is a protocol breach)."
  exit 1
fi

if [ "${MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS:-}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit hook skipped by MIPSTARRE_SKIP_HOOKS=1."
  exit 0
fi

STAGED_FILES="$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR)"
if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: checking staged whitespace."
# Paper mirrors under references/ are byte-faithful captures of external
# arXiv sources (see references/*/README.md); their inherited trailing
# whitespace is part of the fidelity claim and must not be "fixed", so they
# are exempt from the whitespace gate (local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md,
# 2026-08-30).
git diff --cached --check -- ':(exclude)references/'

if printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_FILES" | grep -Eq '^scripts/(.*\.py|tests/.*)$'; then
  echo "MIPStarRE pre-commit: running scripts/tests unit tests."
  run_without_git_local_env python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'
fi

if printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_FILES" | grep -Eq \
  '^(blueprint/src/.*\.(tex|sty|cls)|scripts/(check_blueprint_latex|tex_utils)\.py|scripts/tests/test_check_blueprint_latex\.py|\.githooks/pre-commit)$'; then

 "body": "### Motivation\n\nIssue #273 requires the exact expectation identity for removing the unused EPR\npair from the expanded state.         args.repo_root.resolve(),
        lake=args.lake,
        check_axioms=not args.skip_axiom_check,
        warn_missing_leanok=args.warn_missing_leanok,
    )

def module_source_path(repo_root: Path, module: str) -> Path:
    """Return the local source path for a repository module."""
    return repo_root / Path(*module.split(".")).with_suffix(".lean")


def module_output_paths(repo_root: Path, module: str) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    """Return the expected ``.olean`` / ``.ilean`` output paths."""
    rel = Path(*module.split("."))
    olean = repo_root / ".lake" / "build" / "lib" / "lean" / rel.with_suffix(".olean")
    ilean = repo_root / ".lake" / "build" / "lib" / "lean" / rel.with_suffix(".ilean")
    return olean, ilean


def ensure_module_olean(repo_root: Path, module: str, lake: str) -> str | None:
    """Build a local module on demand when its ``.olean`` is missing.

    This is a fallback used when ``lake build`` has not been run beforehand.
    It only emits the ``.olean`` / ``.ilean`` artifacts the axiom harness
    needs — no C output — since generating C adds significant overhead
    without providing any value to ``#print axioms``.
    """
    source = module_source_path(repo_root, module)
    if not source.is_file():
        return None

    olean, ilean = module_output_paths(repo_root, module)
    if olean.exists():
        return None

    olean.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    ilean.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            lake,
            "env",
            "lean",
            str(source.relative_to(repo_root)),
            "-o",
            str(olean),
            "-i",
            str(ilean),
        ],
        cwd=repo_root,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if proc.returncode == 0:
        return None
    output = _strip_ansi((proc.stdout or "") + "\n" + (proc.stderr or "")).strip()
    tail = "\n".join(output.splitlines()[-10:]).strip()
    return (
        f"could not build missing object file for {module}."
        + (f" Lean output tail: {tail}" if tail else "")
    )


def run_axiom_batch(
    imports: list[str],
    decls: list[str],
    *,
    repo_root: Path,
    lake: str,
) -> tuple[dict[str, DeclAxiomInfo] | None, str]:
    """Run one temporary Lean harness for a batch of declarations."""
    for module in imports:
        build_error = ensure_module_olean(repo_root, module, lake)
        if build_error is not None:
            return None, build_error

    header = [f"import {module}" for module in imports] + [""]
    body = [f"#print axioms {decl}" for decl in decls]
    first_body_line = len(header) + 1
    line_to_decl = {first_body_line + idx: decl for idx, decl in enumerate(decls)}

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        harness = Path(temp_dir) / "BlueprintLeanokAxioms.lean"
        harness.write_text("\n".join(header + body) + "\n")
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [lake, "env", "lean", str(harness)],
            cwd=repo_root,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        harness_path = harness

    output = _strip_ansi((proc.stdout or "") + "\n" + (proc.stderr or "")).strip()
    parsed = parse_axiom_output(
        output,
        decls,
        harness_path=harness_path,
        line_to_decl=line_to_decl,
        returncode=proc.returncode,
    )
    return parsed, output

def _run_decl_axiom_checks_items(
    items: list[tuple[str, list[str]]],
    *,
    repo_root: Path,
    lake: str,
    depth: int = 0,
) -> dict[str, DeclAxiomInfo]:
    """Run ``#print axioms`` on one batch of module imports, splitting on failure."""
    if not items:
        return {}

    imports = [module for module, _ in items]
    decls = [decl for _, module_decls in items for decl in module_decls]
    indent = "  " * (depth + 1)
    print(
        f"{indent}Checking batch: {len(decls)} decl(s) across {len(items)} module(s) …"
    )

        imports,
        decls,
        repo_root=repo_root,
        lake=lake,
    )
    if parsed is not None:
        print(f"{indent}Batch succeeded.")
        return parsed

    if len(items) == 1:
        module, module_decls = items[0]
        tail = "\n".join(output.splitlines()[-10:]).strip()
        reason = (
            f"could not run `#print axioms` after importing {module}."
            + (f" Lean output tail: {tail}" if tail else "")
        )
        print(f"{indent}Batch failed at module {module}.")
        return {
            decl: DeclAxiomInfo(
                exists=True,
                raw=output,
                parse_error=True,
                harness_error=reason,
            )
            for decl in module_decls
        }

    mid = len(items) // 2
    print(
        f"{indent}Batch failed before declaration output; splitting into "
        f"{mid} and {len(items) - mid} module(s)."
    )
    left = _run_decl_axiom_checks_items(
        items[:mid],
        repo_root=repo_root,
        lake=lake,
        depth=depth + 1,
    )
    right = _run_decl_axiom_checks_items(
        items[mid:],
        repo_root=repo_root,
        lake=lake,
        depth=depth + 1,
    )
    left.update(right)
    return left
